text:
ellie (acct exec): Quick ask Partner pilot request from ZenithCare via reseller NexusHealth. They want a 60% off hosted inference pilot for 8 weeks. Reseller says this gets them into 30 hospital sites. Can finance fast-track? :eyes:
sam (finance ops): Need numbers. Pilot estimated tokens 3.2M, list cost ~ $0.028/token -> list ~$89.6k. 60% off = customer pays ~$35.8k, we absorb ~$53.8k. Who books revenue (direct or reseller)? Any co-op credits?
rahul (revops): If reseller is involved, revenue books direct to Redwood but reseller gets 15% rev share on net ARR. Need GL for reseller margin and concession mapping. Suggest pilot credit cap = $40k and require reseller co-marketing agreement.
ellie (acct exec): Reseller insists no upfront fees. They want proof before commit. They promise 12mo expansion if POC milestones hit.
nina (head of finance): Noted. Policy: >50% discount or concessions >$25k requires VP review. For partner-involved deals, require reseller contract, LOI from end customer, and a conversion KPI. We can approve up to 40% discount for pilots under $30k concession. Anything above goes to VP.
marta (legal): We'll need reseller agreement, SOW between Redwood and NexusHealth, and customer LOI. If PHI involved, need BAAs in place before activation. Legal turnaround ~72hrs.
rahul (revops): Operational ask: if we allow 60% to proceed, set a hard pilot credit cap at $40k, require customer LOI with decision date, and require reseller to sign co-marketing AND non-circumvention clauses. Also ensure revshare GL = 5510.
sam (finance ops): Proposed compromise: Approve conditional pilot at 45% off, cap $40k, require reseller agreement + customer LOI + $5k onboarding fee to be invoiced up front (non-refundable). That reduces exposure.
ellie (acct exec): I'll push reseller on onboarding fee and LOI. They might push back on upfront. If reseller refuses, we'll escalate to VP.
partner-bot: /dealdesk create customer=ZenithCare reseller=NexusHealth pilot_discount=45% pilot_cap=40000 onboarding_fee=5000 revshare=15% notes="reseller-led, 8w pilot, 30 sites potential"
finance-bot: Checklist for final approval: 1) Deal desk URL, 2) Customer LOI (pdf), 3) Reseller agreement (pdf), 4) SOW w/ scope & data controls, 5) GL codes for concession and revshare. Finance will issue concession memo after receipt.
nina (head of finance): Conditional approval: up to 45% discount, $40k cap, $5k non-refundable onboarding, reseller agreement + customer LOI required. VP approval needed to exceed any of these.
ellie (acct exec): Got it. I'll update Nexus and loop back with docs. Tagging @marta for legal once reseller agrees. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
